# Eternal Growth

> A student-run tutoring nonprofit on Long Island, New York. High school students, mostly from Syosset and Jericho, tutor elementary, middle and high school students one-on-one, in small groups and online. Eternal Growth has raised more than $35,000, given more than $3,500 to Swim Across America for cancer research, and subsidizes tutoring.

## Pages

- [Home](https://eternalgrowth.org/): what Eternal Growth does and how to request a tutor
- [Subjects](https://eternalgrowth.org/subjects): every subject, its topics and its tutors
- [Impact](https://eternalgrowth.org/impact): money raised, where it went, and projects such as the $10,000 Swim Across America drive
- [About](https://eternalgrowth.org/about): why Eternal Growth started, values and questions
- [Team](https://eternalgrowth.org/team): officers, founders and alumni

## Projects

- The Swim Across America drive: led by Victor Pan with Katherine Fei and Sue Nian, it raised $10,000 in three months, more than $3,500 of it for cancer research.

## Subjects

- Mathematics: From times tables to derivatives, with the problem-solving habits that make the next unit easier.
- English and Writing: Reading closely and writing clearly, from a first book report to a college essay.
- Science: Biology, chemistry and physics, with the lab work and the writing that go with them.
- Coding: How to think like a computer scientist, by building apps, games and small tools.
- Music: Lessons and theory from officers who have played for years, from first notes to a recital.
- Social Studies: History, geography and civics: the stories behind how the world got this way.
- Beyond the Classroom: Skills that help in every class, and a few that go past school altogether.

## Questions

- Who are the tutors? High school students, most from Syosset and Jericho, who know their subject and remember learning it.
- Which grades do you work with? Elementary through high school. College students can ask too.
- Where do sessions happen? In person around Long Island, or online over video.
- How is a tutor chosen? By subject, grade and how your student learns. Tell us what has worked before.
- Where does the money go? To causes across Long Island and beyond, including cancer research through Swim Across America, and to help subsidize tutoring.
- How do I become a tutor? Email info@eternalgrowth.org with the subject you know best.

## Contact
